title: Kagamine Rin — Bringing The Fun And Games♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I hereby declare this emergency meeting of the fun and games committee open☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Come on, Len, show some spirit!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's just the two of us here, so what would be the point?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's important to get into the right mood!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The right mood, huh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, what are we doing today?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
I'm glad you asked! Today...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're gonna plan a party to celebrate Ichika and the girls' solo show getting the green light!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Now I see.
That explains why you came and got me right after they left.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yup!
There's no time like right now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think you mean “the present”.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But a party's a good idea.
This is going to be their very first solo show since going pro.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
So, let's decide what we're gonna do!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Here's my basic plan! We're gonna play music together for the first half, and a bunch of games for the second!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Let's start thinking about the music first, then.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, I wanna do something super fun right after the starting toast!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we have someone play a song? Who should we have...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's your idea, so you, Len.
Who else would be good... Oh, what about KAITO?! You two could have a really awesome session together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure thing. It'll be easy to get the party started with KAITO too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, that settles that♪ Next, we'll have...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Since we're all gonna be there, it'd be nice to play something with Ichika and the others.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! But it's a party, so I kinda want to do something different and special...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Something different, huh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Then, what if we shuffled our bands?
We could all play instruments that we normally don't.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, that sounds really fun! We're so doing that♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, we've got everything down for the first half!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So now we need to come up with games for the second half. Anything you wanna play, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... We could play cards, or have a quiz tournament and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I feel like we should keep doing stuff that's both fun and different!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: In other words, you've got nothing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: B-But thinking up exciting stuff is where the fun and games committee gets to strut their stuff!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, let's figure out games everyone's gonna love♪
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, those are the party plans we came up with for Ichika and the others! What do you all think?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It sounds wonderful.
You have so many fun activities planned, I'm looking forward to it already.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And we'll be more than happy to help set everything up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So I'm up first, huh... I'll need to do my best.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. We'll be looking forward to a good performance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And the games for the second half do look fun... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something wrong, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, it's just... I'm not sure what “Leo/need Old Maid” is.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's a new version of Old Maid that Len and I came up with! You do impressions as you play!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Impressions...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Just think about it. All their names include numbers or are tied to them in some way, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... Like how Ichika's name has a “1” in it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Exactly! Sakki would be a “3”, Hona would be a “7” and Shih would be a “4”!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So whenever you make a pair using someone's number, you have to do an impression of them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. For example, if I made a pair of sevens, then I'd have to do an impression of Honami, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's right! You'd say, “I bought apple pies for all of you,” or something like that♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That sounds fun.
In Saki's case, you'd have to be cheerful and optimistic.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shiho will probably want to avoid doing any impressions, so she might refrain from revealing any such pairs.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't think I could do any either...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I think the fun and games committee deserves a pat on the back for coming up with such an interesting game.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, let's do our best to make sure Ichi and the others all get to have lots of fun☆
